messages_body:
Hi Neha —

Thanks again for the demo earlier. As discussed, Acme Health is moving forward with a security review for Redwood as part of our procurement checklist. Can you share the most recent SOC 2 Type II report, any available bridge letters, and provide us read-only access to your Trust Portal so our security team can pull evidence?

We'd also like to kick off a vendor security questionnaire (we'll send our standard SPI or Security Assessment via OneTrust) — please confirm the right contact for intake. Ideal timeline: questionnaire completed + portal access by next Friday (2027-03-12).

Tom Rivera (cc'd) will own the intake.

Appreciate it —
Alice Chen
Director of IT Risk & Compliance
Acme Health

---
On Mon, Mar 1, 2027 at 3:10 PM Alice Chen <alice.chen@acmehealth.com> wrote:
> Neha — thanks for the session today, attaching the list of high-level controls we care about.

Attachment: Acme_Security_Scopesheet.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

Hi Alice / Tom —

Great to meet both of you on the call. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

1) You requested our SOC 2 Type II report and any recent bridge letters — we'll provide the latest Type II (covering 2026) and a bridge letter that addresses the gap period for a limited set of controls.
2) We'll provision read-only Trust Portal access for your security reviewers. The portal contains evidence artifacts and our control mapping.
3) For the vendor security questionnaire, please send the questionnaire URL or file; we'll coordinate intake via our Security team.

Owner assignments: 
- Redwood portal & artifacts: I'll coordinate with Security (cc'ing internal contacts) and confirm portal invite by end of day Thursday.
- Questionnaire intake: please send the doc; I'll route to Aditya Rao (Trust & Compliance) for response.

Timeline: aiming to provide the SOC2 PDF + bridge letter and portal invite by 2027-03-03. If anything slips we'll update you immediately.

Next step for you: confirm the questionnaire file and any names of reviewers who need Portal access.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0198

Hi Alice/Tom —

Forwarding the portal invite and attached artifacts per Neha's note. Please find: 
- Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2026.pdf (full report)
- SOC2_Bridge_Letter_2027-03-03.pdf (bridge letter covering control changes during Q4 2026 rollout)

Portal access: https://redwood.trustportal.example/acmehealth-12345 (read-only reviewer role). Invite sent to alice.chen@acmehealth.com and tom.rivera@acmehealth.com — please check spam if you don't see the invite.

Notes: the bridge letter documents the scoped control exceptions and compensating controls. If your questionnaire needs evidence we can map questions to specific artifacts in the portal (e.g., change-management evidence, SOC control owner attestations).

Attachment: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2026.pdf
Attachment: SOC2_Bridge_Letter_2027-03-03.pdf

Thanks,
